title: Legal document agent in shadow in rwb-agent (app slice): the consumed operation paths below the rwb-document base, the legal-action read path, the parameter codes and the list codes, the gateway-bff route path, the member types of the pack and of the run answer, and the service login are not specified
source: Legacy story RWB-E2-030 sections 3, 4, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.9 and A2.9.4; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.2, T-A.1 and T-A.2; context pack P10 (service row, schema rwb_agent, base /api/recovery/agent/v1, topic rwb.agent.events.v1, queue rwb-agent, the eight tables, the eleven REST operations and EV-28); Template and Rules v1 R4, R5.4, R5.5 DP-01, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-13, DP-19 and R9; Ownership Map v1 as repeated in the context pack
section: 3. Preconditions; 10. Authority; 11. Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.3 Events published; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13. Solution plan; 15. Screens and states
description: The app slice needs six values that no source fixes, and none of them is invented. (1) The three reads of rwb-document this key consumes - the documents of a case, the checked fields of a document and the checklist of a case type - are named by RWB-P5-E2025-CON as a contract but no source gives their paths below /api/recovery/document/v1. (2) The by-case legal-action read of rwb-litigation is named in the legacy section 12 as LegalActionQueryService.listByCase only, and no source publishes its REST path or its member names. (3) The parameter codes of the minimum scored sample 50 and of the promotion check list, and the list codes behind LOV-AGENT, LOV-AUTONOMY, LOV-CONFIG-STATUS, LOV-EVAL-STATUS, LOV-AGENT-RUN and LOV-SUBJECT-TYPE, are not named: the TSD gives the values of each list but not the code the reference-data contract takes. (4) The name and the path of the gateway-bff route in front of the seven operations are required by DP-19 and given by no source. (5) The member types of the pack - the type of documentIds, the length of itemCode and defectReason - and of the run answer beyond the six members of API-P10-001 are not specified. (6) The rwb-agent service login is required by DP-02, which is not a pattern of this key, and no source names it.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-030 section 12 names only the in-process interfaces DocumentQueryService.listByCase, getFields, getChecklist and LegalActionQueryService.listByCase, and its ApiSpec rows end at /api/recovery/v1/admin/... with no document, litigation or route path; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T-A.1 lists the eleven agent operations only and T3.2 gives list values without codes; Arch v5 slide 8 shows one hop and the gateway-bff route without a path; the context pack repeats the ownership rows of P10 and no document, litigation or route row.
owner_role: Solution architect with the owners of rwb-document, rwb-litigation and rwb-case, and the platform library owner for the route
proposed: Consume the three document reads, the legal-action read, the case read, the parameters and the lists as the story states, each one hop with the 2 s budget and a fake; serve the operations on /api/recovery/agent/v1 behind the gateway-bff route; read the minimum sample and the promotion list as parameter values at load time. The paths, codes, member types and login are settled with their owners before the story's Done.

title: Legal document agent in shadow in rwb-agent (contract slice): the run-start path below the agent base, the consumed boundary paths and field names, the six policy members beyond the baseline, the member types of the pack and the score row, and the gateway-bff route path are not specified
source: Legacy story RWB-E2-030 sections 7, 11, 12 and 13; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.9 and A2.9.3.1; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.2, T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4 components AgentRun, AgentConfigVersion, AgentEvaluation, AgentEvaluationReport; context pack P10 (base, topic, queue, EV-28, the eight tables and the eleven REST operations); Template and Rules v1 R4, R5.4, R5.5 DP-01, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-13, DP-19 and R9; Ownership Map v1 as repeated in the context pack
section: 3. Preconditions; 7. Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC7; 11. Data; 12.1 REST operations provided; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.3 Events published; 15. Screens and states
description: The contract slice needs six values that no source fixes. (1) The sources name the run read GET /agent-runs/{id} on Arch v5 slide 16 and no run-start operation, so the start path and its rights are settled here. (2) The three document reads, the legal-action read and their member names below the bases are not published. (3) The baseline AgentConfigVersion carries autonomyMode and reviewDate but not the evaluation run ID, the promotion conditions, the allowed tools or the output schema reference as request members, so six members beyond the baseline are settled. (4) The member types of the pack - documentIds, itemCode, defectReason - and the exact type of confidence and agreementRate beyond four decimals are not given. (5) The score row is the baseline AgentEvaluation with five members, and the legacy AC2 needs the agreement rate and the sample size only, so the label key set (the checklist codes) is settled here. (6) The route name and path in front of the operations are required by DP-19 and given by no source.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-030 section 12 names the three document and legal-action interfaces in process and no REST start operation; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T-A.1 has no run-start row and T-A.2 API-P10-001 is the admin run list only; the API Specification v4 AgentConfigVersion has no promotionConditions member and AgentRunCompleted carries runId, agent, caseId, outcome and fallback only; Arch v5 slide 16 shows GET /agent-runs/{id} and the queue rwb-agent without a start path.
owner_role: Solution architect with the owners of rwb-document, rwb-litigation and rwb-case, and the platform library owner for the route
proposed: Fix the run start as POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/agent-runs with the idempotency rule; consume the boundary reads at the assumed paths with a fake each; narrow the policy payload with the six members and remove none; fix the pack members and the score row keyed by the checklist code; name the route in the platform story. Every value is settled with its owner before the baseline is tagged.
